registration.order: Rotate L/G/N/GN by case index plus budget index. One warm observation per case/arm/budget; timings descriptive, no inferential speed claim.
registration.required_control: Before creating new note-present study copies, all 20 original v2 replies must be byte-identical. Original roots and traces stay untouched.
registration.note_provenance: Three fixed repo-level researcher recipes based on pre-fix README inspection, not task symptoms/patches. Author/reviewer: implementation agent. Active authoring/review minutes unavailable; automatic instantiation time measured separately. These generic summaries cannot establish hidden-rationale usefulness.

limitations: Dependent public diagnostic cases, incomplete contextual overlap labels, all tasks have a local source answer; one is a feature case. Not independent behavioral success trials.
